payload.title: Best Time to Get Married in Bali by Month
payload.excerpt: Smartraveller says Indonesia's wet season usually runs around October to April, so May to September sits outside that window. Whatever month you choose, every date still needs a covered plan.
key_takeaways: Indonesia's wet season usually runs around October to April, when weather can change quickly and heavy rain can flood roads in Bali.
Bali's BMKG climate station forecasts the start of each rainy and dry season every year, so check the outlook for your year rather than relying on a fixed calendar.
Nyepi falls on Monday 8 March 2027, beside the Idul Fitri holidays and collective leave, so ask your venue early how the day affects guests and suppliers.
Chapels at venues such as AYANA, The Apurva Kempinski and The St. Regis give a wet-season date a covered setting.

faq.q: What is the rainy season in Bali?
faq.a: Smartraveller places Indonesia's wet season usually around October to April, when weather can change quickly and heavy rain can flood roads in Bali. The exact start varies by year and by zone, and BMKG's climate station forecasts it each year.

faq.q: Is there a right or wrong month to marry in Bali?
faq.a: No single month suits every wedding. Months outside the usual wet-season window suit outdoor plans, wet-season months call for a chapel or covered space, and official dates such as Nyepi shape guest travel. Choose by your ceremony setting, guest list and the 2027 calendar.

faq.q: Is December a good time for a wedding in Bali during the wet season?
faq.a: It can be, with a covered plan. December sits within the usual wet-season window, and collective leave on 24 December, Christmas Day on 25 December and Isra Mikraj on 26 December fall together in 2027. A venue with a chapel, such as Cloud Nine Chapel at The St. Regis Bali Resort, gives the day a covered setting.
Nyepi falls on Monday 8 March 2027. Ask your venue how the day affects arrivals, services and suppliers before you hold a date in early March.

faq.q: What happens if it rains on the wedding day?
faq.a: You move to the covered space agreed in your contract. Agree in writing which space is held, whether it seats every guest, and the time by which the weather call is made.
